notes: The circuit image shows force-sensing resistors (two-terminal) as the analog sensors; the catalogue part matched is potentiometer-10k, so each sensor uses only its VCC and SIG pins as the variable resistor (GND pin left unconnected). Pot VCC goes to the + rail (5V), SIG to the divider node.
Each voltage divider: sensor from 5V rail to a breadboard column, 10k resistor from that column to the GND rail, and a yellow wire from the column to an analog pin.
Image shows copy1 at breadboard column 24 -> A0, copy2 at column 16 -> A1, copy3 at column 6 -> A2 (outer yellow wire loop is A0 going to the rightmost sensor).
Breadboard orientation: the image's lower half (rows a-e) is treated as bank 't' and its rails as tp/tn; the upper rails as bp/bn. Rail hole numbers are approximate from the image.
Arduino 5V goes to the upper + rail and GND (second GND header pin, GND.2) to the upper - rail; two jumpers carry both rails to the lower rails at columns 29/30.
Resistor value 10k per the manual; the catalogue default of 100 ohm is overridden with the value prop.
Software (Processing / Max MSP) is not part of the physical build graph.
